messages:
Alice: Quick FYI — PR #4823 is failing CI on the integration test suite, looks like `tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_stream_timeout` repeatedly times out. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/4823
CI-bot: Build 5621 failed on ubuntu-latest (pytest exit code 1). Logs: `E   TimeoutError: stream didn't produce tokens in 30s`
Junaid: @Alice can you paste the failing stack? I'll take a look now :eyes: 
Alice: here's trimmed log:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_stream_timeout
...
E   TimeoutError: stream didn't produce tokens in 30s
--- stdout ---
request id: abc123
server: gpu-pool-12
```
Mary Chen: This test has been flaky on node rebuilds — seen it twice last week. Have we tried rerunning just the job?
Alice: re-run queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5621/rerun
CI-bot: Rerun started (5621.1)
Kevin: I can try repro locally — can someone gimme the exact docker image tag used in CI?
Nina: image: redwood/inference:release-2026-03-10-gpu
Junaid: I dug in — looks like KV cache warmup occasionally delays first tokens when using the new concat patch. Suggest increasing timeout in test to 60s or mock out network.
Alice: I'd prefer fixing test to not be sensitive to timing, but quick patch to get release out: can someone approve bypassing flaky test once? Need one approval and merging to unblock release.
Mary Chen: I'm fine with temporary skip annotated with # flaky and a jira created. @Kevin can you add the skip and jira?
Kevin: will do, pushing patch now
Alice: thanks all. Kevin please ping when CI passes. :pray:
CI-bot: Build 5621.1 failed (same test) — trying again in 3m
Junaid: if still failing after two reruns we should revert the concat patch from PR #4798 and open a follow-up
Kevin: updated PR with skip and JIRA-7893 reference: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/4823
Alice: 👍 merging once green
CI-bot: Build 5621.3 succeeded — merge allowed
Alice: merged. Release pipeline unblocked. Thanks everyone :tada:
